[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Depths of Madness | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=466 }} The [[Depths of Madness]] is the [[explorable area]] beyond the [[Gate of Madness (outpost)|Gate of Madness]]. It is a hellish blood-stained landscape of lava filled burning chasms and mountains of madness. The desecrated [[Temple of the Six Gods|Temple of the Six Gods]] acts as a gateway to the heart of the Realm itself. ==Getting there== The only entrance to this area is via the [[Abaddon's Gate (outpost)|Abaddon's Gate mission outpost]]. ==Shrines== ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: * [[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Margonite Battle]] ** By the [[Temple of the Six Gods]] towards the south. ** Northeast from from the exit into Abaddon's Gate. * [[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Menzies Battle]] ** Near the northwestern corner. ** Northwest from the center, by a bridge. ** Southeast from the center. ** Southwestern corner, at the exit into the [[Abaddon's Gate (outpost)|Abaddon's Gate]]. * [[Forgotten Warden]] → [[Monster Hunt]] ** Near the northeastern corner, close to the exit to the [[Gate of Madness (outpost)|Gate of Madness]]. ; God [[statue]]s: * Shrines with a statue can be found at the [[Temple of the Six Gods]]. However, [[kneel]]ing at these shrines will not summon the representatives of any of the gods, even after the [[Margonite]] guards have been killed.
